subject: Refactor TCL reference to support running tests with CMake (#2816)
reason: The change is purely build and test infrastructure: it refactors CMake files (symlink creation, a 'hint' custom target in src/CMakeLists.txt) and the TCL test harness (tests/support/set_executable_path.tcl and sourcing it from test scripts) so the existing TCL suites can run against CMake-built binaries. No Valkey server, command, replication, persistence, or tool (valkey-cli/benchmark/check-rdb/check-aof) source code is modified, so there is no runtime behaviour a fuzzer scenario could reach or regress.
